transcript.content: Hello, I’m glad you came in. What brings you in today?

I don't know... mostly I just don't feel like myself anymore. I stopped doing things. Hiking... coaching... playing my guitar. I don't really call people back. 

Some days I just sit in my rental for hours. I know there are things I should be doing, but... I just can't make myself start.
How long have you been feeling this way?
A while. I guess... about a year and two months. That's when I moved into this smaller rental. After the divorce. Things just kind of... started unraveling since then.
Have you ever had a similar period of depression like this before?
No... I don't think so. Not that I remember.
Before this past year, did you ever have another episode like this that lasted at least two weeks?
No. Like I said... I didn't. I never really had this problem before. Just... just since the move.
Have you been diagnosed with any medical illness or started any new medication around the time this began?
No... I haven't been sick. I don't really go to the doctor for anything. And I'm not taking any pills.
During this past year, have you felt depressed or down most of the day, nearly every day?
No... not really. I don't... I wouldn't say I feel down all the time. I just... I don't really pay attention to that. I just keep to myself.
During this past year, have you felt sad, down, or depressed most of the day on most days?
I thought you just asked me that. No. I don't feel sad. I just... mind my own business.
Over the past year, have you felt down or depressed most days?
You keep asking me the exact same thing. ...No. I already told you, I don't.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt depressed or down most of the day nearly every day?
I... look. It's the same answer. No. Not for a year, not for two weeks. I'm not depressed.
Over the past two years, have you felt depressed or down more often than not?
I don't... I don't understand why you keep asking me this. I already told you no. I'm not sad. Not for two years, not for one year. Just... no.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things you used to enjoy?

I... I don't know. I guess I just don't feel like myself anymore. I used to hike... coach a bit. Played guitar. I don't do any of that now. I don't even call people back. Sometimes I just... sit in my rental for hours. I know I should do things, but I just... can't make myself start.
Have you felt little interest or pleasure in things most days for at least two years?
No. Not two years. I just... I don't know when it started exactly, but it hasn't been that long.
Over the past two weeks, have you felt depressed or down most of the day nearly every day?
No. I just... I told you, I'm not sad. Not over the past two weeks, either. Just... no.
Have you lost interest or pleasure in things most days?
I don't really keep track of the days. Like I said... I just don't do much anymore. I don't know if it's every single day, it's just... how it is lately.
Over the past two years, have you felt down, depressed, or hopeless more often than not?
No. I... I told you already. I'm not sad. I don't feel hopeless. It's not... just no.
